segments.sn12.33:1.3: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.sn12.33:1.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn12.33:2.1: “Katamāni [katamāni ca (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], bhikkhave, catucattārīsaṃ ñāṇavatthūni?
segments.sn12.33:2.2: Jarāmaraṇe ñāṇaṃ, jarāmaraṇasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, jarāmaraṇanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.3: jātiyā ñāṇaṃ, jātisamudaye ñāṇaṃ, jātinirodhe ñāṇaṃ, jātinirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.4: bhave ñāṇaṃ, bhavasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, bhavanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, bhavanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.5: upādāne ñāṇaṃ, upādānasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, upādānanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, upādānanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.6: taṇhāya ñāṇaṃ, taṇhāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ, taṇhānirodhe ñāṇaṃ, taṇhānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.7: vedanāya ñāṇaṃ, vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ, vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ, vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ;
segments.sn12.33:2.12: saṅkhāresu ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhārasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhāranirodhe ñāṇaṃ, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn12.33:3.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko,
segments.sn12.33:3.4: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo.
segments.sn12.33:4.3: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn12.33:5.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti, idamassa dhamme ñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn12.33:5.2: So iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgatena yaṃ neti.
segments.sn12.33:6.1: “Ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, sabbe te evameva abbhaññaṃsu, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahi.
segments.sn12.33:7.1: “Yepi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇaṃ abhijānissanti, jarāmaraṇasamudayaṃ abhijānissanti, jarāmaraṇanirodhaṃ abhijānissanti, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhijānissanti, sabbe te evameva abhijānissanti, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahīti.
segments.sn12.33:8.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni –
segments.sn12.33:8.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno itipi, dassanasampanno itipi, āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, passati imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, sekkhena ñāṇena samannāgato itipi, sekkhāya vijjāya samannāgato itipi, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno itipi, ariyo nibbedhikapañño itipi, amatadvāraṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati itipīti.
segments.sn12.33:10.3: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn12.33:11.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako evaṃ saṅkhāre pajānāti, evaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti, idamassa dhamme ñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn12.33:11.2: So iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgatena yaṃ neti.
segments.sn12.33:12.1: “Ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhāre abbhaññaṃsu, saṅkhārasamudayaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, saṅkhāranirodhaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññaṃsu, sabbe te evameva abbhaññaṃsu, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahi.
segments.sn12.33:13.1: “Yepi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhāre abhijānissanti, saṅkhārasamudayaṃ abhijānissanti, saṅkhāranirodhaṃ abhijānissanti, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhijānissanti, sabbe te evameva abhijānissanti, seyyathāpāhaṃ etarahi.
segments.sn12.33:14.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni –
segments.sn12.33:14.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno itipi, dassanasampanno itipi, āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, passati imaṃ saddhammaṃ itipi, sekkhena ñāṇena samannāgato itipi, sekkhāya vijjāya samannāgato itipi, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno itipi, ariyo nibbedhikapañño itipi, amatadvāraṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati itipī”ti.

lines: Jarāmaraṇe ñāṇantiādīsu catūsu paṭhamaṃ savanamayañāṇaṃ sammasanañāṇaṃ paṭivedhañāṇaṃ paccavekkhaṇañāṇanti catubbidhaṃ vaṭṭati, tathā dutiyaṃ.
Tatiyaṃ pana ṭhapetvā sammasanañāṇaṃ tividhameva hoti, tathā catutthaṃ.
Iminā dhammenāti iminā catusaccadhammena vā maggañāṇadhammena vā.
Atītānāgate nayaṃ netīti “ye kho kecī”tiādinā nayena atīte ca anāgate ca nayaṃ neti.
Ettha ca na catusaccadhammena vā maggañāṇadhammena vā sakkā atītānāgate nayaṃ netuṃ, catusacce pana maggañāṇena paṭividdhe parato paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ nāma hoti.
Seyyathāpāhaṃ, etarahīti yathā ahaṃ etarahi catusaccavasena jānāmi.
Anvaye ñāṇanti anuaye ñāṇaṃ, dhammañāṇassa anugamane ñāṇaṃ, paccavekkhaṇañāṇassetaṃ nāmaṃ.
Imasmiṃ sutte khīṇāsavassa sekkhabhūmi kathitā hoti.
Paṭhamanti “jarāmaraṇe ñāṇan”ti evaṃ vuttaṃ ñāṇaṃ, yena dhāraṇaparicayamanasikāravasena pavattaṃ sabbaṃ gaṇhi.
Sabhāvato paccayato cassa pariggaṇhanañāṇaṃ sammasanañāṇaṃ tveva veditabbaṃ.
Imassa hi dhammassa adhigamahetu ayaṃ ariyo atītānāgate nayenapi catusaccadhamme abhisambujjhati.
Maggañāṇameva pana atītānāgate nayanasadisaṃ katvā dassetuṃ “maggañāṇadhammena vā”ti dutiyavikappo vutto.
Ñāṇacakkhunā diṭṭhenāti dhammacakkhubhūtena ñāṇacakkhunā asammohapaṭivedhavasena paccakkhato diṭṭhena.
Yasmā tathā diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sabbaso pattaṃ mahāupāyo hoti, tasmā vuttaṃ “pariyogāḷhenā”ti.
Diṭṭhenāti vā dassanena, dhammaṃ passitvā ṭhitenāti attho.
Viditenāti cattāri saccāni viditvā pākaṭāni katvā ṭhitena.
Pattenāti cattāri saccāni patvā ṭhitattā dhammaṃ pattena.
Atītānāgate nayaṃ netīti atīte ca anāgate ca nayaṃ neti harati peseti.
Idaṃ pana paccavekkhaṇañāṇassa kiccaṃ, satthārā pana maggañāṇaṃ atītānāgate nayanasadisaṃ kataṃ taṃmūlakattā.
Atītamaggassa hi paccavekkhaṇaṃ nāma hoti, tasmā maggañāṇaṃ nayanasadisaṃ kataṃ nāma hoti, paccavekkhaṇañāṇena pana nayaṃ neti.
Taṃ ākāraṃ dassetuṃ “ye kho kecī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Kiñcāpi “imināti maggañāṇadhammena vā”ti vuttaṃ, duvidhaṃ pana maggaphalañāṇaṃ sammasanañāṇapaccavekkhaṇāya mūlakāraṇaṃ, na nayanassāti duvidhena ñāṇadhammenāti na na yujjati.

Tathā catusaccadhammassa ñātattā maggaphalasaṅkhātassa vā dhammassa saccapaṭivedhasampayogaṃ gatattā “nayanaṃ hotū”ti tena “iminā dhammenā”ti ñāṇassa visayabhāvena ñāṇasampayogena tadañātenāti ca attho na na yujjati.
Anuayeti dhammañāṇassa anurūpavasena aye bujjhanañāṇe diṭṭhānaṃ adiṭṭhānayanato adiṭṭhassa diṭṭhatāya ñāpanato ca.
